name: e2e-pseudo-language-pack
description: Minimal offline stand-in for Microsoft's qps-ploc language pack, used only to make VS Code accept `--locale=qps-ploc` in E2E tests. Its own translations are empty (VS Code's core UI stays English) — this only needs to exist so `vscode.env.language` resolves to `qps-ploc`, which is all GitLens' own l10n catalog selection depends on.
